label: def:interval_integral
title: Interval integral
statement: For a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ (where $E$ is a normed space) and $a, b \in \mathbb{R}$, the \emph{interval integral} $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$ is defined as $\int_{[a,b]} f\,d\mu - \int_{[b,a]} f\,d\mu$ where $\mu$ is a given measure (typically the Lebesgue measure). This definition is antisymmetric: $\int_a^b f = -\int_b^a f$. In Mathlib this is \texttt{intervalIntegral}.
